Ordered controller and device polls

replayr_poll_stream.Rd

Multi-controller M64 and DTM files store ordered samples without per-sample port IDs. The S3 class replayr_poll_stream retains the decoded controls and original bytes. polls() returns one row per poll, with port = NA_integer_, digital controls, source numeric channels, selected stick fields, and command bits. DTM and CTM streams also expose format-specific poll flags. button_layout() maps digital keys to stable IDs. analog_channels() and stick_channels() select the single stored stream with idx = 1.

Details

n_frames() counts polls; n_players() returns NA_integer_. player() requires an assigned controller and therefore directs callers to polls(). If emulator evidence establishes a repeating polling order, supply controller_order to read_m64() or read_dtm() to construct a replayr_movie. The format-specific help explains how player indices map to physical controller ports.

CTM stores separate pad, touch, and auxiliary-device events. Its observation flags identify which controls were sampled; observed_inputs provides the per-control mask. Mixed DTM adds device family and physical port when known. Wii reports marked valid_report = FALSE preserve missing source payloads.

See also

read_m64, read_dtm
